inline-size.comment: A raw dimension on purpose, following `modal.width-*`. Tier 2 `size` carries control-height, target-min and bar-thickness - a drawer's extent has no semantic ancestor there, and inventing one would put a drawer-shaped value in the public layer where every component could reach it. Tier 3 is private and per-component, which is exactly what this is.
